svg.title: ReplyWise Local — A local-first WhatsApp CRM that drafts replies with per-contact memory, and sends nothing until you approve it. Built with Node.js, Express, whatsapp-web.js, Gemini / Groq, Docker.

g.text: A local-first WhatsApp CRM that drafts replies with
per-contact memory, and sends nothing until you approve it.

svg.text: Can we move it to 6 pm?

g.text: Sure — 6 pm works. See you then.
